label: E78 soldier (placed: feet on the 766 world floor, k = 1.431)
prompt: A lone soldier in dented steel armour and a torn surcoat walks slowly toward the camera through drifting smoke on a muddy medieval battlefield at dusk, glancing around at the burning wooden palisade; broken spears and fallen banners lie in the mud. Firelight flickers orange on the smoke and on his armour, a low orange sun glows through the haze under a deep blue sky with dark clouds, the ground dark and in shadow. The camera is locked at one spot, level, no zoom, no pan; only the soldier, the smoke and the flames move. Real footage, natural colour, 35mm lens, deep focus, steady exposure.
